the robustness of algorithms of latent tree structure learning and the impossibility of structure learning of latent tree models.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the sample complexity of CLRG is optimal up to logarithmic factors, and NJ is suboptimal by a factor of the square root of sample size.
CLRG is the best among these algorithms in the sense of sample complexity.
CLRG is the most efficient algorithm for learning the structure of a latent tree model with vector observations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CLRG is the most robust among all existing methods for learning Gaussian latent tree models.
the robust version of the Chow-Liu algorithm for learning latent tree structure with vector variables is optimal.
the Chow-Liu initialization is a crucial step for CLRG to achieve optimal sample complexity.

CLRG is a very robust and efficient method for learning the structures of latent trees.
